text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Trainer. I'll be able to run again before you know it.
choice_data_list: It's fine. You should rest for today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, after I've rested a little, do you think I can run again for a bit?
choice_data_list: You'll only make your condition worse if you push it.
As soon as you feel better, you can run as much as you want!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, after I've rested a little, do you think I can run again for a bit?
choice_data_list: You'll only make your condition worse if you push it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um… Do you think you could keep an eye on me so I don't go off running?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure I have… the discipline.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I respect Suzuka's request and stay by her side in the infirmary until nightfall.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I won't be able to run today, right? What a shame. It's still so bright out…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unable to run due to her injury, Silence Suzuka falls into a mental slump.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Okay. I'll get better as soon as possible, for the sake of running.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I want you to search for lots of beautiful places to go running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Silence Suzuka is burning with determination despite her injury. I should get to finding new running courses right away.
